title: Missed-Visit Fee Waiver, Due-Date and Refund Terms by Appointment Series Format
content:
Patient Financial Services sets the following terms for missed-visit fees on each Appointment Series format: how many first-occurrence courtesy waivers a patient may have, which waiver grounds the format recognises, the time limits for emergency documentation, waiver requests, payment and refunds, the unpaid balance that stops new bookings, and whether an HSA or FSA card may be used.

## Waiver terms

| Visit format | Courtesy waivers per calendar year (across all of the patient's series) | Waiver for a documented medical or family emergency | Emergency documentation due within (calendar days after the missed appointment) | Waiver when the telehealth connection failed | Waiver request accepted within (calendar days after assessment) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 1 | Yes | 7 | Yes | 14 |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 1 | Yes | 7 | No | 14 |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 1 | Yes | 7 | No | 14 |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 1 | Yes | 7 | No | 14 |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 1 | Yes | 7 | No | 14 |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 2 | Yes | 7 | No | 14 |

The telehealth connection waiver covers a visit that failed because the connection failed on the clinic's side or was verified as failed on the patient's side.

## Payment and refund terms

| Visit format | Fee due (calendar days after assessment) | Unpaid missed-visit fees past due at or above which no new appointments are booked | HSA or FSA card accepted for a missed-visit fee | Paid fee refunded after a waiver within (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 30 | USD 35.00 | No | 10 |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 30 | USD 50.00 | No | 10 |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 30 | USD 65.00 | No | 10 |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 30 | USD 55.00 | No | 10 |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 30 | USD 85.00 | No | 10 |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 30 | USD 50.00 | No | 10 |

The booking-stop amount is measured on the unpaid missed-visit fee balance on the patient's series that is past its due date.

## Points of reading (hypothetical figures)

- A Post-Operative Priority Visit Series patient has two first-occurrence courtesy waivers available in a calendar year; every other format allows one.
- On a Standard 45-Minute Visit Series, unpaid missed-visit fees past due of USD 50.00 reach the booking-stop amount; USD 49.99 does not.
- No format accepts an HSA or FSA card for a missed-visit fee.
